nativeMetadata.approvalEffect: approve immediately removes pendingSkills and creates linkedSkills plus symlinks; permissions are not stored in the modules manifest.
nativeMetadata.upgradeEffect: Changing a local tarball selector to v2 removes v1 links and creates pendingSkills for v2. The old grant remains. Approving v2 links guide and the newly added added skill under one package permission.
nativeMetadata.denialEffect: Denying the exact selector immediately writes build:false and skills:false, removes links and linkedSkills, and leaves no pendingSkills.
nativeMetadata.removalEffect: Removing the dependency removes links; saved permission decisions remain.
